dslRule:
<!id: jface.document.getLineOffset.fix>
<!description: Fix incorrect usage of IDocument.getLineOffset by providing a line number instead of an offset.>
<!severity: ERROR>

$document.getLineOffset($match.getOffset())
:: instanceof($document, "org.eclipse.jface.text.IDocument") && instanceof($match, "org.eclipse.jface.text.IRegion")
=>
$document.getLineOffset($document.getLineOfOffset($match.getOffset()))
;;
summary: Corrects the misuse of `IDocument.getLineOffset` by ensuring a line number (obtained via `getLineOfOffset`) is passed instead of a raw offset.
